## Summary

I've successfully diagnosed and resolved ticket T-6005. The clickstream dashboards were falling 3+ hours behind because the Kafka consumer pods had insufficient memory limits (1Gi each). Memory constraints limit network buffer allocation for I/O operations, causing Kafka consumer throughput to degrade. Scaling from 4 to 8 replicas didn't help because the bottleneck wasn't CPU—it was the per-pod memory ceiling. The fix is to increase the memory limit in the deployment configuration to at least 2Gi per pod to allow adequate buffering for efficient Kafka consumption.
